o.text: From Proto-Turkic *kīr- (“to enter”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰚𐰃𐰼 (kir- /⁠kir²⁠/), Turkish girmek, Chuvash кӗр (kĕr) etc.
From Arabic قَهْوَة (qahwa). Compare Gagauz kafä, and Turkish kahve.
From Proto-Common Turkic *čeŋe. Cognate with Turkish çene, see there for more.
Calque of Russian полити́ческое бюро́ (politíčeskoje bjuró).
